Flat Roofs

We lay new rubber and GRP flat roofs over extensions, garages, dormers and bay windows, put in rooflights and roof lanterns if you'd like more light below, and repair or recoat flat roofs that leak.

Call 01472 306134 WhatsApp Us

Rubber Flat Roofs

The rubber roofs in our photos are grey, dressed up to the tiled roof above and trimmed along the edge, and on one outbuilding the new rubber roof sits right next to the old felt that's still on the shed beside it, so you can see the difference.

Rachel C in Grimsby had a new rubber flat roof, her chimney capped and a new roof window fitted, and we finished a day ahead of schedule.

GRP Fibreglass Roofs

Alex Lee is trained by TuffStuff on their Flexiplus and Flexible GRP flat roof systems. In one of the photos the grey topcoat is being rolled on around a roof lantern; the other photos show flat roofs finished up to chimneys, parapet walls and tiled slopes, and over bay windows with new edge trim.

Repairs and Recoats

A leaking flat roof doesn't always need replacing. In Lincoln a customer needed the fibreglass roof on their dormer inspected for their house insurance, and we cleaned and recoated it. In York we repaired the flat roof over a bay window, and took photos first to show what was wrong and how we'd fix it.

How Long It Takes

Most of our jobs take 1 to 3 days. The new flat roof in Scunthorpe took 2.

Signs a Flat Roof Needs Work

  • Water coming through the ceiling under an extension or dormer
  • Rainwater still standing on the roof a few days later
  • Felt that has blistered, cracked or lifted at the edges
  • Moss or weeds growing on the roof
